title: CreateTestCaseResolutionStatus
description: Schema to create a new test case result resolution status.

testCaseResolutionStatusDetails.description: Details of the test case failure status.

severity.description: Severity failure for the test associated with the resolution.

stateId.description: Incident this status applies to: the stateId of one of the test case's incidents. A test case can hold more than one open incident. When omitted, the status applies to the test case's latest incident. With the New status it must name an open incident, whose status New only restates (as a severity change does): New on a resolved incident starts a new one.
